name: Paragraphs table
description: This module provides both a field formatter and a widget for the Paragraphs entity type
project_description:
Project Paragraphs table it looks like module field collection table 

 
 Shows table mode in new/edit 
 Display view with table vertical or horizontal 
 support display suite 
 support field permission 
 operation like field collection table (modify, delete, duplicate) 
 support Datatable 
 support Boostraptable 
 With big table can use ajax 
 
 For Drupal 8 

- Support google chart if you can't see your chart you have to verify arrayToDataTable Examples 

 Some function not work yet. (You can propose your solution, I hope module works like field collection table)

 
 Add new form page pharagraphs in view display mode (it works with ajax) 
 Edit / duplicate form in view mode will not work with image field (I really don't know why) 
 
 best use with theme Bootstrap 5admin
